fusions.name: Snatched Morsel
fusions.desc: Bites an enemy up to 3 tiles away that carries one of your afflictions for 8 damage, rising to 1.2 times that at full reach, and uses up that affliction. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Spoils for the Table
fusions.desc: Rakes everything around you, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Dropped Offering
fusions.desc: Restores 15 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Fishbone Charm
fusions.desc: You wear a fishbone charm that raises your critical chance by 5%, your critical damage by 15% and your movement speed by 4%, and restores 5 health each time you kill.
